RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberReceptionistText:
Welcome to this
chamber.

There are sliding
panels that depict

a #MON drawn by
the ancients.

Slide the panels
around to form the picture.

To the right is a
description of the #MON.

Scientists in the
back are examining

some newly found
patterns.
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistCryptic:
Recently, strange,
cryptic patterns have appeared.

It's odd. They
weren't here a little while ago…

You should take a
look at the walls.
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistHoleTex:
Ah! Here's another
huge hole!

It's big enough to
go through!
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistTremorT:
That tremor was
pretty scary!

But I'm more
concerned about this wall here…
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberUnusedText:
The patterns on
the wall appear to be words!

And those sliding
stone panels seem

to be signals of
some kind.

I think they make
#MON appear,

but it's not clear
yet…
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberWallHoleText:
There's a big hole
in the wall!
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberAncientReplicaTe:
It's a replica of
an ancient #- MON.
RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberDescriptionText:
A #MON that hid
on the sea floor.

Eyes on its back
scanned the area.
